notes: Read all 180 source lines line by line before editing and preserved the BulkAction/BulkActionsToolbarProps public shape, selectedIds/count logic, itemNoun plural selection, optional total display, null return when no rows are selected, action ordering, onClear behavior, and local pending state keyed by action id.

Converted the web GlassPanel/div/span/Button/ConfirmDialog/useConfirm/Tailwind implementation to React Native GlassPanel/View/AppText/Pressable/Modal primitives using existing native design tokens; className remains accepted for source compatibility but is intentionally ignored because native uses StyleSheet styles.

Preserved destructive confirmation behavior by routing actions with confirm payloads through a native modal that carries title, description, confirmLabel, and danger/warning intent before invoking action.onClick(selectedIds).
Preserved i18n intent with the original bulk.* keys and fallback strings via a native-safe translation fallback helper, including {{count}} and {{total}} interpolation for selected/of-total labels.

Mapped web data-bulk-action attributes and aria-live/region intent to native testID values, accessibilityLiveRegion, accessibilityRole toolbar/button/alert, and accessibilityState busy/disabled without importing DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components.
